 WEST PALM BEACH, Fla. (CBS12) — The Powerball jackpot has grown to an estimated $674 million for Saturday’s drawing after no ticket matched all six numbers Wednesday night.
 The winning numbers drawn Wednesday, Oct. 21, were 1, 21, 44, 50 and 57, with a Powerball of 5. The Power Play multiplier was 2X. The jackpot for that drawing was estimated at $635 million.
 The estimated cash value for Saturday’s jackpot is $283.9 million before taxes. Jackpot winners can choose an annuity paid over 30 graduated payments or a lump-sum cash payment.
 At $674 million, the prize would rank below the 10 largest Powerball jackpots in the game’s history. The current 10th-largest prize was $768.4 million, won in Wisconsin in 2019. A California ticket holds the record: a $2.04 billion jackpot won in November 2022.
 See also: More than 4.3 million toothpaste tubes recalled, including children’s brands 
 Two tickets, sold in Ohio and Pennsylvania, matched five numbers and the Power Play to win $2 million each. A ticket sold in New Jersey matched five numbers to win $1 million.
 Powerball drawings are held Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays at 10:59 p.m. ET. CBS12 News is your home for Powerball. Watch the drawing live Saturday and check back for the winning numbers.
